title.narrative: Increased awareness of good States’ practices in implementing UNCAT.
Number of CTI implementation tools developed, sharing technical advice and good State practices developed, translated and disseminated to relevant stakeholders.

target.value: 4 CTI implementation tools on extradition, on complaints and investigations, and on non-admission of torture-evidence developed and disseminated; an animated video on CTI and UNCAT obligations released; blogs on countries’ experiences shared.

actual.value: CTI implementation tools on extradition, on complaints and investigations, and on non-admission of torture-evidence developed and disseminated; an animated video on CTI and UNCAT obligations released; blogs on countries’ experiences shared.

title.narrative: Increased awareness among States of the benefits of UNCAT obligations for administration of justice, social stability, sustainable development and public trust in State institutions,

Active bilateral engagement (study visits and in-country delegation visits etc.) with targeted non-States-parties and new States parties of UNCAT to analyse obstacles and needs to live up to standards of UNCAT.

target.value: 3 diplomatic and/or technical delegation visits and seminars on UNCAT to ODA-approved countries (2019).

actual.value: Diplomatic and/or technical delegation visits and seminars on UNCAT to developing countries conducted to Angola, Dominica and Tonga.
